senses.gloss: f. (זהר) looking out; strictly observant; careful, on one’s guard.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:1">Ab. II, 1</cite> <he>הוי ז׳ וכ׳</he> be as strict in the observance of minor religious duties &c.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:13">Ib. IV, 13</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 33b:4">B. Mets. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>הוי ז׳ בתלמזד</he> be careful in teaching the Law, v. <cite ref="G00072"><he>זָדוֹן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 76b:2">Snh. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>הוי ז׳ במי שיועצך וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מן היועצך</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) beware of him who advises thee to his own advantage.

<cite ref="Shabbat 23b:7">Sabb. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>הז׳ במזוזה</he> he who is strict in the observance &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="G00714"><he>זְהִירִין</he></cite>, f. <cite ref="G00100"><he>זְהִירוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:3">Ab. II, 3</cite> <he>הוו ז׳ ברשות</he> beware of the officials.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:6">Sabb. II, 6</cite> <he>על שאינן ז׳ וכ׳</he> because they are not careful in the observance of the laws concerning &c.; a. fr.
